name: hero-dithering
blurb: Hero with dithering pattern shader backdrop and AI SDK tech badges.
description: Responsive hero with heading, description, CTA, and tech badges. Animated Dithering shader on desktop (swirl pattern, cyan on black, 1280×720) and mobile. Context-based with overridable parts.
use_when: AI/SDK landing page with retro or pixel-art aesthetic via dithering effect.
avoid_when: Shader-intensive. Requires sized parent. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
a11y: Screen-reader title (srTitle). Buttons and links focusable. Shader is decorative.
